title: Improper input validation in the beacon handler for WF200 firmware versions 3.17.0 and earlier may… (CVE-2026-107359)
description: CVE-2026-107359 is a vulnerability in the WF200 firmware versions 3.17.0 and earlier where improper input validation in the beacon handler can cause a divide-by-zero fault. This flaw can lead to a denial of service condition. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
